ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The upper half of the figure is labeled nitrate and shows three resonance structures of nitrate; in each resonance structure, the central N is connected to three O atoms, with one N=O double bond and two N–O single bonds. The lower half of the figure is labeled nitrite and shows two resonance structures of nitrite; in each resonance structure, the central N is connected to two O atoms, with one N=O double bond and one N–O single bond. Reasoning: For nitrate, the total N–O bond order in each resonance structure is 2 + 1 + 1 = 4, distributed over 3 N–O bonds, so the average bond order is 4/3. For nitrite, the total N–O bond order in each resonance structure is 2 + 1 = 3, distributed over 2 N–O bonds, so the average bond order is 3/2. Since 3/2 is greater than 4/3, the average N–O bond order of nitrite is higher. A higher bond order usually means a shorter bond length and higher bond energy, so the N–O bonds in nitrite are shorter and stronger than the N–O bonds in nitrate.

method.method_draft: From the image, count N–O bond orders across the resonance forms. For nitrate, each structure has one double and two single N–O bonds, so the total bond order is 4 spread over 3 N–O bonds, giving average bond order 4/3. For nitrite, each structure has one double and one single N–O bond, so the total bond order is 3 spread over 2 N–O bonds, giving average bond order 3/2. Since 3/2 is greater than 4/3, nitrite’s N–O bonds have higher average bond order. Therefore nitrite has shorter bonds and higher bond energy/stronger bonds than nitrate.

推理：对 nitrate，每个共振式的 N–O 总键级为 2 + 1 + 1 = 4，分布在 3 个 N–O 键上，所以平均键级为 4/3。对 nitrite，每个共振式的 N–O 总键级为 2 + 1 = 3，分布在 2 个 N–O 键上，所以平均键级为 3/2。因为 3/2 大于 4/3，nitrite 的平均 N–O 键级更高。键级更高通常意味着键长更短、键能更高，因此 nitrite 的 N–O 键比 nitrate 的 N–O 键更短、更强。
